title: Cal. Code Regs. tit. 10, section 2320 - Effective Date; Construction of Provisions (Marine Insurance article)
publisher: Cornell Legal Information Institute, reproducing the California Code of Regulations
claims: The section is headed Effective Date; Construction of Provisions and states that the article is effective January 1, 1954 and supersedes former sections 2320, 2321 and 2322.
The section states that where provisions substantially match the superseded sections they shall be construed as restatements and continuations of those provisions and not as new provisions.
The page places the article at title 10 (Investment), chapter 5 (Insurance Commissioner), subchapter 3 (Insurers), article 5 (Marine Insurance).
updateCadence: The article carries a 1954 effective date. This reproduction shows no amendment history, so check the official California Code of Regulations before relying on currency.
